title: Direction-Aware Token Credit Assignment with Reward-Model Gradients
abstract: arXiv:2610.32772v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: GRPO shares a response-level advantage across tokens, leaving unresolved how strongly each token should contribute to learning. Updates induced by the shared advantage reinforce or suppress the sampled token at each position, but these updates do not always point toward increasing reward at the token level. This motivates a work-based view of credit: just as work depends on the component of force along a displacement, token credit should reflect the local reward change along the policy update direction. We introduce Direction-Aware Token Credit Assignment (DATC), which maps frozen reward-model gradients into policy logit space and allocates weights by evaluating the alignment between the reward direction and GRPO's signed sampled-action update direction, while preserving the sign and mean of the response-level advantage. DATC outperforms GRPO in all four settings across two model families.

translated_title: 基于奖励模型梯度的方向感知词元信用分配
translated_abstract: GRPO 在所有词元间共享响应级别的优势，但尚未解决每个词元应以多大强度参与学习的问题。由共享优势所引发的更新会强化或抑制每个位置上采样的词元，但这些更新并不总是指向词元级别上奖励的提升。这启发了一种基于“功”的信用分配视角：正如功取决于力沿位移方向的分量，词元信用应当反映策略更新方向上的局部奖励变化。我们提出了方向感知词元信用分配（DATC），该方法将冻结的奖励模型梯度映射到策略 logit 空间，通过评估奖励方向与 GRPO 带符号的采样动作更新方向之间的一致性来分配权重，同时保持响应级别优势的符号与均值。DATC 在两个模型家族的全部四种设置中均优于 GRPO。
tldr: 提出方向感知词元信用分配方法 DATC，利用冻结奖励模型的梯度来度量奖励方向与 GRPO 更新方向的对齐程度，从而为每个词元分配信用权重，在两个模型家族的四种设置中均优于 GRPO。
en_tdlr: DATC leverages frozen reward-model gradients to measure the alignment between the reward direction and GRPO's update direction, assigning direction-aware credit weights to individual tokens and consistently outperforming GRPO across four settings on two model families.
